description: PAID ($0.009 USDC via x402). Who is actually earning on x402: every seller (host) in Coinbase's public x402 discovery index, read hourly, with its 30-day paid calls, paying wallets, calls per payer (near 1.0 = a one-off sweep, higher = repeat buyers), estimated revenue (calls × listed price, counted only for resources priced in USDC on a known chain), median price, networks and its most-called resource. Rank by revenue, calls or payers; filter by keyword (e.g. "search", "token safety") and network; minPayers (default 3) drops sellers whose only payers are their own testers. Useful to price a product, find who sells what, or pick a provider by evidence. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

minPayers.description: Only sellers with at least this many paying wallets on one resource (default 3 — fewer is usually a single tester)

network.description: Only resources on this network ("base", "solana" or a CAIP-2 id like eip155:8453)

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

q.description: Only sellers with a resource matching these words (e.g. "search", "token safety")

sort.description: Rank by estimated 30-day revenue (default), 30-day calls, or paying wallets

note.description: How the revenue and payer figures are built, and their limits

source.description: The index the data comes from

stale.description: True when that read is more than 3 hours old

totals.description: Totals over every seller that passed the filters
